name: Worship and the altar guild
summary: Readers, intercessors, chalice bearers, ushers and the altar guild who set the table before every service.
body:
Three services every Sunday: a quiet said Eucharist at 8:00, the sung Eucharist with the choir at 10:30, and Evensong or Compline at 17:00. On Wednesdays there is a short said service at 7:00 for anyone on the way to work.

The altar guild changes the hangings each season, so the colors you see on this site are the colors you will see on the altar.

name: Music and the Wyndleford Choir
summary: A twenty-four voice parish choir, a children's choir, and the 1911 Hollins organ.
body: The choir sings at the 10:30 every Sunday and at Advent Lessons and Carols, Christmas Eve, Holy Week and Easter. No audition: if you can find the note eventually, come on Thursday.

name: Children and families
summary: Sunday school in the Lantern Room, the nursery, the pageant and a monthly parents' circle.
body: Children start the 10:30 in church, go to the Lantern Room after the first reading, and come back in time to share communion. The nursery is staffed from 10:15 every Sunday.

name: Youth: the Upper Room
summary: Supper and conversation for grades 6 to 12, a summer service week and the Advent supper.
body: Pizza, a question nobody is allowed to answer too quickly, and Compline at the end. Two Sundays a month during the school year.

name: The Ferry Street Pantry
summary: A food pantry in the parish hall serving about 140 households a week, run with three other churches in Wyndleford.
body: The pantry has run every Thursday since 2009. Shoppers choose their own groceries, like a small corner shop. Volunteers stock shelves, drive collections from the farmers' market and sit at the welcome table.

name: Pastoral care
meets: Visits by arrangement; Lay Eucharistic Visitors on the first Sunday
summary: Hospital and home visits, communion taken to people who cannot come to church, the casserole list and the prayer list.
body: If you or someone you love is in hospital, call the parish office or tell any of the clergy. The prayer list on this site is kept by the pastoral team: some names are read aloud, some are shared with members, and some stay with the clergy.

name: Study and formation
summary: Seasonal studies, confirmation classes and the Tuesday morning Bible study.
body: This Advent the Wednesday study reads the Gospel of Mark start to finish, one evening per four chapters, alongside the Sunday readings.

name: Buildings and grounds
meets: Tuesdays 8:00, and one Saturday work morning a month
summary: The Tuesday crew who look after a 1887 stone church, its bell tower, the rectory garden and the churchyard.
body: Gutters, hinges, hymn boards, the boiler that predates most of the congregation. Coffee is at 10:00 sharp.
